bifrost: bifrost_app::usernotif (springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs), shell registry springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs, delivery UI springboard/src/shell/notify/
summary: Local notifications are covered: categories with buttons, destructive and text-reply actions, requests with title, subtitle, body, thread, category, a time-interval delay and a Dock badge, removal and listing of delivered and pending requests, and the user's response (also queued for an app that is not running). Remote push (APNs, device tokens, background push, the notification service extension), calendar and location triggers, communication notifications, attachments, per-request sounds, notification settings queries and the foreground presentation delegate are not covered.

features.note: Permission is a static manifest entry ("notifications"); there is no runtime prompt, no authorization options (alert, sound, badge) and no authorization status query. Without the permission every add answers NotPermitted.

features.apple: UNUserNotificationCenter add, removeDeliveredNotifications, removePendingNotificationRequests, getDeliveredNotifications, getPendingNotificationRequests
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs (add, remove_delivered, remove_pending, delivered, pending); springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs (Registry)
features.note: Covers add with identifier replacement, removal by identifier or all, and the delivered and pending lists. Pending is capped at 64 per app (MAX_PENDING); no per-notification sound, no interruption level.

Taps and action buttons arrive as Event::Response, including text-reply text, and are queued when the app is not running. No willPresent hook: the app cannot choose presentation options for a notification that arrives while it is in front.

features.bifrost: springboard/proto/src/rich.rs (NotifCategory, NotifAction, TextInput), springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs (set_categories), docs/bifrost-ui.md section 'User notifications'
features.note: Buttons, destructive and foreground actions and text-input actions with a placeholder are covered (up to 16 categories of 10 actions). Action icons, category options (custom dismiss action, hidden preview) and the dismiss-action callback are not.

features.apple: UNNotificationRequest, UNMutableNotificationContent (title, subtitle, body, threadIdentifier, categoryIdentifier, badge, sound)
features.note: Title, subtitle, body, thread, category and badge are covered. No sound name, no launch image, no userInfo, no interruption or relevance level.
Only the time-interval trigger exists (after_ms, a delay in milliseconds). No repeating interval, no calendar components trigger, no location region trigger, no push trigger.

Wave 2 (user-notifications-ui, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No attachment API. Notification cards show text only. The shell has image drawing (springboard/render/src/imgdec, springboard/src/shell/notify/list.rs) that could carry an image thumbnail.
Sounds can be turned off per app in Settings. An app cannot choose a sound per request, and there is no critical or default sound API.

features.feature: Notification display (banners, lock screen, Notification Center)
features.apple: System presentation of local and remote notifications (Human Interface Guidelines > Notifications)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/notify/mod.rs (banner, lock screen stack, Notification Center), springboard/src/shell/notify/banner.rs, springboard/src/shell/notify/store.rs
features.note: The shell draws banners that slide down, stacks on the lock screen and in Notification Center, swipe to clear, and tap to open after unlock. Passcode hides the text on the lock screen.

Wave 4 (w4-user-notifications, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The user side is complete: per-app lock screen, Notification Center, banner, badges, previews and grouping, plus Do Not Disturb and per-app mute. Apps get no API to read their authorization settings or the Focus status (UNNotificationSettings is not exposed in the SDK).
A badge number on a request and a short label on the dock icon are both available.

features.apple: APS Environment entitlement, registerForRemoteNotifications, device token, Setting up a remote notification server
features.note: No device token, no push registration and no remote delivery path. The desktop has a cloud backend (~/Projects/bifrost-cloud) but no push channel to apps. APNs itself is Apple's service and has no direct counterpart; a BifrOSt push service would be new work.

features.feature: Background push and notification service extension
features.apple: UNNotificationServiceExtension, background push (content-available), Modifying content in newly delivered notifications
features.note: Depends on remote push, which is missing. No app extension point runs between delivery and display.
No sender-based notification styling and no intent-backed message content. App Intents exist but are not wired into notification content.

features.apple: Sending web push notifications in web apps and browsers
features.note: No Push API or service worker push in the Browser app (the webview is Servo, see docs/bifrost-ui.md). Needs a push service and browser support.

features.feature: APS entitlements and push testing tools
features.apple: APS Environment (macOS) entitlement, Sending push notifications using command-line tools, Push Notification Console
features.note: Entitlement and Apple-hosted testing tools belong to APNs. Nothing to match until remote push exists.

gaps: Remote push: no device token, no push registration, no background push wake-up (APNs or a BifrOSt equivalent).
Notification service extension: no hook to modify a notification before it is shown.
Calendar and location triggers: only a time-interval delay exists; no repeating or region-based notifications.
Attachments and per-request sounds: notification cards are text only and the sound is a per-app switch.
Runtime permission flow and settings query: permission is a manifest flag; there is no authorization status, no request options and no UNNotificationSettings equivalent.
Foreground presentation delegate (willPresent): an app cannot choose how a notification shows while it is in front.
Communication notifications and web push: no sender-based message notification and no Push API for the browser.
